pli-tv-bi-vb-pc4:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc4:1.2: tena kho pana samayena aññataro purāṇarājorodho bhikkhunīsu pabbajito hoti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc4:1.3: aññatarā bhikkhunī anabhiratiyā pīḷitā yena sā bhikkhunī tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā taṃ bhikkhuniṃ etadavoca
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc4:1.4: rājā kho ayye tumhe cirāciraṃ gacchati
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc4:1.8: athakho sā bhikkhunī tassā bhikkhuniyā jatumaṭṭhakaṃ ācikkhi.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc4:1.9: athakho sā bhikkhunī jatumaṭṭhakaṃ ādiyitvā dhovituṃ vissaritvā ekamantaṃ chaḍḍesi.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc4:1.13: yā tā bhikkhuniyo appicchā …pe… tā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc4:1.14: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhunī jatumaṭṭhakaṃ ādiyissatīti …pe…
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc4:1.15: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave bhikkhunī jatumaṭṭhakaṃ ādiyatīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc4:1.18: hi nāma bhikkhave bhikkhunī jatumaṭṭhakaṃ ādiyissati
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc4:1.20: evañca pana bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddisantu
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc4:2.4: samphassaṃ sādiyantī antamaso uppalapattampi muttakaraṇaṃ paveseti āpatti pācittiyassa.
